description: This file implements the PaymentTypeWriteService interface, providing methods to create, update, and delete payment types within the Fineract platform. It manages database interactions, validation, and exception handling related to payment type entities.

classes.name: PaymentTypeWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PaymentTypeWriteService interface, handling creation, update, and deletion of payment types with cache management and exception handling.

methods.name: createPaymentType
methods.description: Validates input and creates a new PaymentType entity, then persists it and returns a result.

methods.name: updatePaymentType
methods.description: Validates input, fetches existing PaymentType, applies updates, persists changes if any, and returns a result.

methods.name: deletePaymentType
methods.description: Deletes a PaymentType entity after checking for data integrity issues, handling exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles specific data integrity issues during delete operations, throwing appropriate exceptions.
